findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 4E0D
findings.details: [OCR CORRECTION REQUIRED] 《字源》 2012, PDF page 1050 / printed page 1035, OCR raw opening span `靡靠孔斢乞孔乳不` is running-header text, not an 不 headword line; the page scan shows the 不 entry beginning in the lower right column under `不部`. Propose removing this raw locator span as headword evidence rather than substituting a guessed correction. PDF page 1050 continues into the 不 entry at its lower edge; PDF page 1051 begins with its continuation and then a new 至部 entry. Scan pixels directly inspected for both pages. The corpus record’s `printed_page` is null although the page image reads 1035; source metadata needs that verified printed page recorded separately.
findings.verification: Check the identified printed page and exact scan span; correct source-bound OCR or record an unresolved glyph identity.
